foreground_sampling.interpretation: All existing saved main-display window dumps are audited, with command copies counted once. The recorded focus applies at sampled instants; unsampled gaps and foreground interaction responsiveness remain unmeasured. Zero main-display input is a separate routing fact.

interpretation: Six actual local LFM2.5-8B-A1B NPU requests produced five accepted, dispatched nonstale clicks: booking entry, departure picker, Beijing, arrival picker and Shanghai. The final verified form still required departure-date selection and offered its date control, but the model chose failure-done while incorrectly narrating that searching and selection were complete. No calendar selection, query reservation or query dispatch occurred. No new initial-unavailable retry or typed pre-dispatch recovery marker was emitted; this case does not qualify those new branches. The business goal remains failed, with no host Stop or host timeout.
